title: Payload type advisor
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL; QR Code Generation, 2.3 Choosing between a generic DVC and the ICVP; QR Code Generation, 2.4 Decision summary.

statements.label: Payload type advisor
statements.requirement: The library MAY provide an advisor that implements the decision summary: ICVP for IHR entry requirements; DVC (-6) when the content must verify offline and fits in a QR code; VHL (5) otherwise. It SHOULD report an estimated HC1 length so that "fits in a QR" is decided on numbers.
